---
title: "Raw vs BHZIP Metrics Across Three Run Options"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## 1) Load Packages

```{r packages}
required_pkgs <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "readr", "stringr", "forcats")
missing_pkgs <- required_pkgs[!vapply(required_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing R packages: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
```

## 2) Input Paths

```{r paths}
run_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~run_option, ~folder,
  "Server_SnapATAC", "D:/Codex/Test/downloaded_results/oocyte_zygote_raw_vs_bhzip_10runs_snapatac",
  "Server_InnerProduct", "D:/Codex/Test/downloaded_results/oocyte_zygote_raw_vs_bhzip_10runs_innerproduct",
  "Local_InnerProduct", "D:/Codex/Test/results/oocyte_zygote_raw_vs_bhzip_10runs_varyseed"
) %>%
  mutate(per_run_csv = file.path(folder, "per_run_metrics.csv"))

missing_files <- run_map %>%
  filter(!file.exists(per_run_csv))

if (nrow(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing per_run_metrics.csv for:\n",
    paste0(" - ", missing_files$run_option, ": ", missing_files$per_run_csv, collapse = "\n")
  )
}
```

## 3) Read and Combine Data

```{r read_data}
read_one <- function(run_option, csv_path) {
  df <- readr::read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  required_cols <- c("method", "run", "seed")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("File missing required columns (", csv_path, "): ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  df %>%
    mutate(run_option = run_option)
}

all_df <- purrr::map2_dfr(run_map$run_option, run_map$per_run_csv, read_one)

id_cols <- c("run_option", "method", "run", "seed")
metric_cols <- setdiff(names(all_df), id_cols)

long_df <- all_df %>%
  filter(method %in% c("raw", "bhzip")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(metric_cols), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c(
      "ari_k-means", "ari_agglomerative", "ari_gmm", "ari_louvain", "ari_leiden", "best_ari",
      "silhouette_k-means", "silhouette_agglomerative", "silhouette_gmm", "silhouette_louvain",
      "silhouette_leiden", "best_silhouette", "best_silhouette-gt"
    )),
    method = factor(method, levels = c("raw", "bhzip")),
    run_option = factor(run_option, levels = c("Server_SnapATAC", "Server_InnerProduct", "Local_InnerProduct"))
  )

invisible(long_df)
```

## 4) Summary Table (Mean +/- SD)

```{r summary}
summary_df <- long_df %>%
  group_by(run_option, method, metric) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = sum(!is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(metric, run_option, method)

summary_fmt <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(mean_sd = sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", mean, sd)) %>%
  select(run_option, method, metric, mean_sd, n)

invisible(summary_fmt)
```

## 5) Boxplot: Raw vs BHZIP Across Three Run Options

```{r plot_box_all, fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
p_all <- ggplot(long_df, aes(x = run_option, y = value, fill = method, color = method)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.68,
    alpha = 0.30,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.78)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.60,
    size = 1.4,
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      dodge.width = 0.78,
      jitter.width = 0.10
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(raw = "#4E79A7", bhzip = "#E15759")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(raw = "#2F5D8A", bhzip = "#B63D40")) +
  labs(
    title = "Raw vs BHZIP by Metric and Run Option",
    subtitle = "Three run options: Server SnapATAC, Server InnerProduct, Local InnerProduct",
    x = "Run Option",
    y = "Metric Value",
    fill = "Input",
    color = "Input"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_all)
```

## 6) Boxplot: Facet by Run Option (3 Rows), X Axis = Metric

```{r plot_box_by_run_option, fig.width=15, fig.height=12}
p_by_run <- ggplot(long_df, aes(x = metric, y = value, fill = method, color = method)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.30,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.60,
    size = 1.2,
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      dodge.width = 0.78,
      jitter.width = 0.10
    )
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ run_option, nrow = 3, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(raw = "#4E79A7", bhzip = "#E15759")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(raw = "#2F5D8A", bhzip = "#B63D40")) +
  labs(
    title = "Raw vs BHZIP by Metric (Faceted by Run Option)",
    subtitle = "Three rows: Server SnapATAC, Server InnerProduct, Local InnerProduct",
    x = "Metric",
    y = "Metric Value",
    fill = "Input",
    color = "Input"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_by_run)
```


## 7) Save Outputs

```{r save_outputs}
out_dir <- "D:/Codex/Test/downloaded_results/combined_plots_three_runs"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

readr::write_csv(long_df, file.path(out_dir, "combined_per_run_long.csv"))
readr::write_csv(summary_df, file.path(out_dir, "combined_summary_mean_sd.csv"))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "raw_vs_bhzip_three_runs_all_metrics_boxplot.png"),
  plot = p_all,
  width = 16,
  height = 26,
  dpi = 220
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "raw_vs_bhzip_facet_by_run_option_metric_xaxis.png"),
  plot = p_by_run,
  width = 16,
  height = 14,
  dpi = 220
)

cat("Saved outputs to:", out_dir, "\n")
```
